Quota & Usage

YouTube usage recorded on this PC. Connection diagnostics are under Help / Tutorial.

What is YouTube quota?
Quota is Google's daily usage limit for the YouTube API. FyFlade uses quota units when it finds channels, connects to live chat or performs YouTube actions. This is not money and you are not charged. If the limit is reached, YouTube features may stop until the next reset.
